PICK ONE 
Pick a card to unlock the stamp.

THE MUSEUM OF MYSTERY SOLIDS

The museum is dark. Five mystery solids arrived tonight, and their record cards are blank. You are the Night Curator — examine each one and file its true record before morning.

Drag a solid to turn it. Tap a card. Press STAMP to file the record.
No one will say right or wrong tonight: every filed card is sealed for the Head Curator.

LEAVE THE MUSEUM?

Records you already filed stay sealed. Exhibits you have not opened will be marked "not opened".

THE SHIFT REPORT

The morning bell rings once. The wings you lit stay lit.
